subject: Follow-up: SLO gating details + Lighthouse self-run concurrency rehearsal
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Lighthouse discovery recap + next steps for customer-led rehearsal

Quick recap from this morning's call with Lighthouse (Tom/Aisha). They are bullish on Redwood for the low-latency routing use case but want to validate SLOs with a customer-run load window before committing to Dedicated capacity. Key acceptance criteria buried in the conversation: 

- Latency SLO: p95 generation <= 350ms for single-turn text gen (non-streamed) across typical 32-token prompts.
- Streaming SLO: sustained 95th percentile for streaming chunk delivery <= 120ms for 2–3 chunk streams (video-transcription-like use case).
- Throughput target for rehearsal: steady-state 160 concurrent sessions, peak bursts up to 400 for 90s windows.
- KV/cache warmup: they will simulate realistic session affinity (we should enable prefix cache to mirror demo).

They want to run the rehearsal themselves (Lighthouse engineers will execute k6 scripts) but need: allowlist for test IPs, test service account with scoped test creds, and a short run-of-show. They proposed a 3-hour window on Wed 17 Mar 2027 15:00–18:00 ET.

Action items for us (assign):
- Marissa: create test account + scoped API key, pre-populate model variant pinned to rwd-ggml-2b-quant for the run. (Due Tue EOD).
- Connor: validate streaming hook traces, enable per-token tracing flags for the rehearsal, and prepare a perf dashboard link. (Due Tue EOD).
- Priya (me): send formal MoM to Lighthouse with mutual action plan, attach k6 script variant, request allowlist CSV, confirm test window. (I'll send now.)

Notes: keep the test account rate limits generous but throttle by IP so customer doesn't accidentally spike other tenants. We'll also supply an emergency fallback model variant with lower capacity weight if they exceed our target.

--
Priya
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Subject: Follow-up & mutual action plan — Lighthouse rehearsal window and SLOs

Hi Tom / Aisha,

Thanks again for the call — great alignment. Quick written recap and the mutual action plan so we have a single source of truth ahead of your customer-led rehearsal. Please reply with any adjustments.

Recap (short): Lighthouse will run a customer-led k6/Locust-style rehearsal to validate latency and streaming SLOs prior to contract signature.

Acceptance criteria (from our conversation):
- Latency (non-stream gen): p95 <= 350ms over 30m steady-state
- Streaming chunk delivery: p95 <= 120ms (measured at Redwood's edge to client)
- Throughput: 160 concurrent steady-state, with 3x burst tests up to 400 concurrent for ~90s each

Mutual action plan / timeline:
1) Today (Mon 15 Mar): You provide final test IP ranges and the primary test lead name/email.
2) Tue 16 Mar EOD: Redwood creates test service account + API key, shares run_of_show + perf dashboard. (Attachment: run_of_show.pdf)
3) Wed 17 Mar 15:00–18:00 ET: Customer-led rehearsal. Redwood engineer on standby (Marissa) and Connor monitoring traces.
4) Thu 18 Mar: Post-test debrief and SLO signoff.

Attachments included: lighthouse_k6_v2.json (k6 script variant we discussed), run_of_show.pdf (outline / escalation path). Please confirm the IPs to add to your allowlist and let us know if you need any script tweaks.

Logistics notes: do not share the API key outside of the named test lead. We'll provide an allowlist CSV for your security team to import. If you expect more than 400 peaks, tell us now so we can provision a temporary burst pool.

Next steps for you: reply with (1) chosen test window confirmation, (2) test IP ranges, (3) test lead name & phone.

Looking forward —
Priya
--

- We plan to use your provided k6 script but will swap in our custom payload generator; if you have a hook for the generator to respect the KV key prefix we discussed, please include it.

Attachments: allowlist.csv, security-contacts.vcf
